records.assetReview: First schematic network has two stages, four branches each. Total 4 L/s is 80 px and each branch 1 L/s is 20 px at common 20 px/(L/s). Absolute nodes 104,102,100 kPa give two 2 kPa drops. Second network retains two stages and total rate but two branches: each 2 L/s is 40 px, nodes 108,104,100 give stage drops 4 kPa. Last comparison is a separately labeled B with three stages and two branches: bars at 60 px/(kPa·s/L) sum 30+30 = 60 and 60+60+60 = 180. All separate arrow markers and full native image read; network geometry is explicitly schematic.
records.distractors: All channels in series would give 16; all in parallel would give 1/4; 2 is a single-channel resistance. Neither alternative respects the network nodes.
records.manualArithmetic: Four equal parallel channels give one stage resistance 2/4 = 1/2 kPa·s/L. Two stages add to 1 kPa·s/L; eight physical channels are not eight series resistances.
records.physicalAssumptions: Horizontal incompressible steady network, linear positive identical channel resistances, ideal nodes without accumulation or extra losses, no bypass between nonconsecutive stages. Positive total rate is common to stages and branches share each stage pressure. N_s and N_p are positive integer counts, fixed within a trial. Display readings are continuous dimensionless signals, not physical channel counts.
